gaps.gap: MLPA cannot detect single-letter changes or small insertions/deletions in the DMD gene, so a sequence-level variant remains unexcluded.

next_check.cannot_show: It cannot detect deep intronic variants, variants in other dystrophy genes, or confirm the muscle pathology itself.
